11:38.text: And as he was constructing the ship, whenever the chiefs of his people passed by him, they mocked at him. He said: "If you mock at us, so do we mock at you likewise for your mocking.

11:39.text: "And you will know who it is on whom will come a torment that will cover him with disgrace and on whom will fall a lasting torment."

11:40.text: till when Our Command came and the oven gushed forth
. We said: "Embark therein, of each kind two
, and your family - except him against whom the Word has already gone forth - and those who believe. And none believed with him, except a few."

11:41.text: said: "Embark therein: in the Name of Allâh will be its
anchorage. Surely, my Lord is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

11:42.text: sailed with them amidst waves like mountains, and Nûh
called out to his son, who had separated himself
: "O my son! Embark with us and be not with the disbelievers."

11:43.text: replied: "I will betake myself to some mountain; it will save me from the water." Nûh
said: "This day there is no saviour
from the Decree of Allâh except him on whom He has mercy." And waves came in between them, so he

11:45.text: called upon his Lord and said, "O my Lord! Verily, my son is of my family! And certainly, Your Promise is true, and You are the Most Just of the judges."
